inference: Original has ordinary attach/detach CRT dispatch with termination context; it is not shown here to require a cooperative pre-unload API. Presence of a detach path is not proof that arbitrary live FreeLibrary is safe.
unknowns: Whether the actual host normally calls FreeLibrary on this image or keeps it for process lifetime.
Whole-image absence of module pinning or another external admission protocol; only the seven named functions were inspected in this slice.
Runtime races, native hot-unload safety, and production replacement behavior.

primary_document.supports: reserved is NULL for FreeLibrary/failed load and non-NULL for process termination; detach need not use attach thread; process termination may leave process resources inconsistent.
